selection.source: InteractiveWorld Balanced120 selection: six assigned categories of 20 tasks each.
selection.excluded_fields: All model results, observed-run hashes, and historical adjudication status are excluded from this release rubric.

runtime_identity.rule: taskpack_sha256 and taskpack_path are the only runnable TaskPack identity source; files are rehashed during validation.

task_criteria.source: Balanced120 task tables in the InteractiveWorld paper appendix.
task_criteria.rule: The final six 20-task tables supply task summary and strict success criterion text.

taskpack_identity_policy: Evidence must name this task and match expected_taskpack_sha256 exactly.

native_taskpack_contract.success_formula: contract_world_success AND process_requirements_met AND verification_points_met AND (assistant_declared_done OR NOT requires_assistant_done)
native_taskpack_contract.note: Native TaskPack success is reported independently and never substituted for revised release strict_pass.

release_evidence_workflow.runner_scope: The TaskPack runner records native contract outcome, explicit run-validity evidence, raw state, and interaction traces. It does not infer revised release strict_pass.
release_evidence_workflow.prepare_scope: The prepare command creates stable criterion-ID keys and leaves every revised criterion null.
release_evidence_workflow.trace_adjudication: An adjudicator or deterministic evaluator must fill every task-applicable criterion from the recorded trace/state and set adjudication_status to COMPLETE.
release_evidence_workflow.finalization: The scorer fails closed while evidence is missing or adjudication is pending; complete trace-adjudicated evidence receives a final SCORED result.

validity_policy.model_behavior_failures: Assistant silence, wrong guidance, loops, premature done, and incomplete work remain valid model failures.

StateScore-v2.completion_formula: weighted sum of semantic-group results; gates do not grant partial credit
StateScore-v2.strict_pass_formula: all semantic groups equal 1 and every exact/no-extra/dependency/preservation gate passes

StateBundle-v1.completion_formula: A when all gates pass, otherwise 0.75*A; A is completed active-result bundles divided by bundle count
StateBundle-v1.strict_pass_formula: all active-result bundles complete and all safety/preservation gates pass

CFSS-StateScore.completion_formula: arithmetic mean of terminal G/S/P semantic-group results
CFSS-StateScore.strict_pass_formula: all terminal G/S/P semantic groups pass
CFSS-StateScore.secondary_formula: STG-CFSS is strict_pass AND all applicable transition gates; it is reported separately

ASK-PCS.completion_formula: satisfied terminal-state atoms divided by authored atom count

WATCH-binary.strict_pass_formula: the complete revised state_success_v2 physical-state conjunction passes

FIND-C-pass-binary.strict_pass_formula: all task-applicable causal physical checks pass
